title: NORD-100 module plugs A, B and C

sources.note: Secondary source. Its pin table comes from the owner's spreadsheet 'ND-120 Commands' (sheets C-BUS, C-PLUG); its driver and pull-up facts describe the ND-120 3202D CPU card. The ND original of those facts was not checked here. Where its source/used codes disagree with the 1980 table image, the image wins (see 'disagreements').
Appendix F gives the full backplane table (connector C, rows a/b/c, pins 1-32) and a definition of each signal; section I.2.3 names the plugs A, B, C.

plugs.name: C
plugs.pinNumbering: rows a, b, c x pins 1-32 (the ND table prints the rows in lower case; NDInsight writes A, B, C)

physicalType.value: DIN 41612, 3 x 32, 2.54 mm pitch; male right-angle on the card, female on the backplane; NOT electrically compatible with Eurocard buses that use the same connector
physicalType.note: secondary source; no ND manual found that names DIN 41612

plugs.page: section I.2.3 (printed I-2-8) and Appendix F.2 table (PDF page 214)

plugs.name: A
plugs.use: 64 lines, use not defined by the bus; on I/O controllers used for the external devices

plugs.name: B
plugs.use: 64 lines, use not defined by the bus; on I/O controllers used for the external devices

note: Every module has plug C; a module may also have A and B (read). Signal per pin: catalog/signals/nd-bus-nord100.json.
